decisive_spans.text: no irregular cyst shapes were noted

response.rationale: The presence of numerous round, thin-walled air cysts and recurrent spontaneous pneumothoraces strongly supports Lymphangioleiomyomatosis (D6). The specific mention of 'no irregular cyst shapes were noted' directly contradicts the typical irregular cyst shapes seen in Birt-Hogg-Dube syndrome (D5), making D6 a much stronger candidate.
